scope: NTTE + Uncharted Frontier mobile port only

requirements.request: 修复红水晶洞窟隐藏小路附近的错误墙体堵住普通道路。
requirements.acceptance: Use the final repair-specific scheduled native generation/traversal case to preserve pre-population open-road points and edges, forbid safe-spawn shifts after Red population, and retain ordinary Warp and hidden-room round trips. Current wall-contact and wall-art regression cases remain required.
requirements.root_cause: A native safe-spawn floor shift ran after hidden-room walls and helpers had been appended, displacing ordinary roads from their collision geometry. Disable safe spawning only in this Red GenCont population callback after its original pre-population shifts have finished.
requirements.supplementary_evidence: Bind the original failing 96-seed control and a fresh positive 96-seed control to their receipts, compiler inputs and artifact hashes. The positive control must use the same final VM/input as the 21 formal cases; diagnostics do not count as formal acceptance.
requirements.rock_scope: Retain candidate rock IDs outside the actual native PortalClear collision mask. Record and count native clearance candidates separately; preserve all sampled remaining rock IDs through settling and both traversal round trips.

requirements.request: 修复安卓版机器人重启页面偶发缺少 YES/NO 按钮。
requirements.acceptance: Actual native GUI-End rendering must show each button across four viewport/GUI mappings. Separate real death, raw touch, delayed cleanup, Cyberspace and destination cases must pass at 30/60Hz.

requirements.request: 修复 Slash 撞墙时 scrNTTESolidWallContact 访问已删除实例的崩溃。
requirements.acceptance: The actual merged Slash/Wall collision must safely retire a destroyed wall and preserve live-wall collision, contact-array and collision-stack behavior at 30/60Hz.

requirements.request: 修复警局选择 IDPD 变异时中文字体挤在一起。
requirements.acceptance: Measure nonoverlapping title/body/replacement layouts for all IDPD augment definitions in both Simplified Chinese and English, and retain screenshots from the real rendering path.

requirements.request: 在视频设置中加入默认开启、可自由开关并保存的自动降帧选项。
requirements.acceptance: Test the real Video confirmation, default and saved settings, budget recovery, pause guards and unit preservation. An actual 60→30→60 callback run must preserve physical travel, native alarms and source ticks. Actual collision callbacks across 60→30→60→30 must preserve physical Bullet2 wall-bounce units and logical NTUF/Red/Venom/CustomShell units.

requirements.request: 泡泡开启技能后普通武器攻击和技能泡泡攻击同时发射，偏好文字为“按下技能后同时进行泡泡攻击”。
requirements.acceptance: Actual General/controller/touch firing must consume weapon ammo and bubble charge together at 30/60Hz, stop on release, preserve charge and clicked state, and retain independent control when the preference is off.

evidence_limits.native_runtime: Isolated Windows GameMaker VM, private desktop never activated, muted resources, isolated saves.
